headline: Hear the script, read the score
highlights: ⌃Space reads the script line aloud in the clip's identified language — Space plays the take, ⌃Space the text, the ear compares.
A TTS voice manager: pick a voice per language, and a one-click path to Apple's free premium voices (most Macs ship with only the compact tier).
Japanese diffs compare character by character — perfect matches finally read green — and the match score is a big aligned number on every row.
Assign offers only the names a clip's language can still take.
